name: CONNIE
summary: CONNIE searches for reactor-antineutrino coherent scattering in silicon at Angra-2 in Brazil. The transition from conventional scientific CCDs to Skipper-CCDs lowers the ionization threshold to the few-electron regime.
detection_principle: Nuclear recoils in fully depleted silicon create electron-hole pairs collected in pixels. Repeated nondestructive Skipper sampling resolves single-electron charge. Reactor-on/off spectra, spatial event selections and shielding separate a possible CEvNS signal from background.
